# skills/BR_Legacy/SKILL.md

---
name: BR_Legacy
description: Design or build any Blue Roster screen in the Blue Roster Legacy style (Figma "Design System Legacy"). Use when the request says @BR_Legacy, Blue Roster, Blue Roster Legacy or BR. Also covers Blue Roster marketing (banners, questionnaire landing, blueroster.com) through Marketing mode.
---

# @BR_Legacy — Blue Roster Legacy skill

Invoke with `@BR_Legacy <simple request>`, e.g. `@BR_Legacy agenda para que el admin vea quién faltó y quién trabaja hoy`.
Repo: https://github.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system · Raw base: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/`
Full context in one file: `llms-full.txt`.

## Cheat sheet (memorize before starting)

| Event | Token | Light | Dark | Text on it |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shift | `--br-event-shift-neutral` | #d1d5db | #373c4b | normal text |
| Tasks | `--br-event-shift` | #1e75f6 | #6ea3ff | white |
| Overtime | `--br-event-overtime` | #1c9646 | #1c9646 | white |
| Planned overtime | `--br-special-4` | #5a2ead | #5a2ead | white |
| Leave / absent | `--br-event-leave` | #ef4444 | #ef4444 | white |

- Hex values are for reading only. In code use the CSS variables from `tokens/tokens.css`.
- Time: 12h (`6:00 am - 4:00 pm`, hour labels `5 AM`). Dates: `Thu 8 Oct 2026`. Default day range is 5 AM–4 PM.
- Calendar geometry: 48px per hour; overlapping events sit in equal side-by-side columns (`patterns/calendar-layout.md`).
- Type: Roboto (some legacy components use Inter, a known inconsistency, so do not copy it). Icons: Material Icons Outlined (`<span class="mi">name</span>`). The filter icon is `filter_alt`.
- Filters: 1–3 inline; 4 or more go in one `br-filter-dialog` opened by `br-filter-button`.
- Mobile first: 390 → 768 → desktop. Light (`:root`) and Dark (`[data-theme="dark"]`).
- Employee shell: `br-app-shell` with `App=Employee`. Admin specs are drawn at 1440×900.
- **Light and Dark side by side:** event tokens such as `--br-event-shift-neutral` are aliases (`var(--br-neutral-light)`). An alias resolves where it is declared, so if it only lived on `:root`, a `<div data-theme="dark">` inside a Light page kept the Light event colors. `tokens/tokens.css` now re-declares all 74 alias tokens on `[data-theme="light"], [data-theme="dark"]`, so `data-theme` works on any container out of the box. If you copy tokens into another file, keep that alias block (or use one iframe per theme).
- **Event block overflow (My Schedule Day, 3+ overlapping):** the title stays on one line with an ellipsis; the time line is hidden when the column is under 120 px wide or the event lasts 1 h (40 px tall); with 4+ overlapping events show 3 columns plus a `+N` pill (`br-m-event-more`) for the rest. `starter/br-m.css` and `starter/my-schedule-day.html` implement it (`is-compact` class).
- **Proposals (new, not in Legacy):** coverage holes (`--br-event-hole`, `br-event-hole`, `br-coverage-warning`) and Shift swap request cards live in `proposals/` and Figma page "Proposals · not in Legacy". Use them only when the user asks for coverage holes or shift swap, and label output "Proposal — new, not in Legacy".
- Day sample (`fixtures/schedule.json`, Thu 8 Oct 2026) now has all 5 event types: Shift, Tasks, Planned overtime 5–6 am, Leave 12–2 pm, Overtime 5–7 pm (placeholders reusing existing fixture text; range extended to 7 PM). Overlapping events go side by side in columns.

## Workflow

### 1. Find the closest screen
Open the keyword → spec table in `llms.txt` (or `AGENTS.md` → Playbook) and match the request words. Name the spec you picked and why. If two match, pick one and say so.

### 2. Start from what exists, never from scratch
For the chosen spec, load:
- the spec `screens/<group>/<name>.md` (read its **Anatomy** section),
- the PNGs `screens/<group>/img/<name>-light.png` and `-dark.png`,
- the node tree `screens/<group>/json/`,
- the closest starter in `starter/` (`my-schedule-day.html`, `admin-attendance-today.html` (approved, desktop 1440), `components.html`) with `starter/br-m.css`.
Copy the starter and edit it. Keep its classes, spacing and structure.

### 3. Use only Blue Roster tokens and formats
- Colors: `br/*` tokens only (`--br-…`), events per the cheat sheet (`tokens/events.md`).
- Spacing, radius and type: `--spacing`, `--radius-*`, `--text-*`, `--font-weight-*`.
- Formats per `patterns/formats.md`. No hard-coded hex, rgb or px where a token exists.

### 4. Reuse components
Use only what is documented in `components/` and shown in `starter/components.html`: `br-m-app-bar`, `br-m-page-header`, `br-page-tab`, `br-m-legend`, `br-m-date-nav`, `br-m-timeline`, `br-m-event-block`, `br-m-status-pill`, `br-m-avatar`, `br-chip`, `br-button`, `br-filter-button`, `br-filter-dialog`, `br-table` and Mobiscroll (`br-mobiscroll-*`) for calendars. Do not redraw a component in raw HTML.

### 5. Missing pattern? Compose it and flag it
If no spec covers the request (for example a multi-employee mobile calendar):
1. Compose it from existing pieces: schedule and timeline (`my-schedule-day`), event blocks, legend, date nav, avatars, status pills and filters.
2. Label it in the output: **"Composed pattern — pending design approval"**.
3. Write an **Assumptions** list (layout, states, colors chosen, copy, data) and a **Questions** list for the designer.
4. Never invent new tokens, components, business rules, prices or legal text. Unknown items stay `TBD`.
5. Use sample data only from `fixtures/schedule.json`, or neutral placeholders such as "Employee 1". No real-looking names.

### 6. Self-check before you answer
- [ ] I named the spec and starter I followed.
- [ ] Every color is a `--br-*` variable, and the event colors match the cheat sheet.
- [ ] Times are 12h, dates look like `Thu 8 Oct 2026`, hours run 5 AM–4 PM unless the spec says otherwise.
- [ ] Roboto plus Material Icons Outlined; no Inter, no other icon sets.
- [ ] Filters: 1–3 inline, 4+ in `br-filter-dialog` with `filter_alt`.
- [ ] Only existing components; no new ones were invented.
- [ ] Mobile 390 first; Light and Dark both work (`?theme=dark`).
- [ ] Composed patterns are labeled, with Assumptions and Questions listed.
- [ ] Placeholder data only, and gaps are marked `TBD`.
- [ ] One view delivered; I am asking for review before the next one.

## Marketing mode (banners, landing, blueroster.com)
Use this instead of steps 1–6 when the request is about a banner, post, LinkedIn/Instagram/Story, campaign, the questionnaire landing, Wix or a blueroster.com section.
1. Read `marketing/README.md`, then `marketing/foundations.md` (decisions, colors, 20 `mkt` text styles, grid, spacing) and `tokens/marketing.css` (`--mkt-*`).
2. Landing or form → `marketing/landing.md` (`mkt-*` components, flow, copy, Wix notes). Banner or post → `marketing/banners.md`. Match the PNGs in `marketing/references/`.
3. Inter only (Black for display/H1 and banner headlines; H2–H4 Semi Bold). Light page; Navy `#002458` only as a band. Buttons `#064DB7` + White on light, White `#F9F9F9` + Navy text on Navy. `#1E75F6` is never text. Orange `#F66C1E`: accent only, Navy text on it, never white, never a button.
4. Copy verbatim from blueroster.com or approved lines; headlines in sentence case + period. Approved stats only, per vertical. No quotes, testimonials, names, prices or "free" (say "light version", up to 50 users). Links in the first comment. Market: US only.
5. Screen banners: Attendance Today, My Schedule Day, Overtime cards, Light captures at 2x, role-based example data, current dates, no real names.
6. Self-check: text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 and minimum sizes per format; every line has a source; gaps stay `TBD`. Output: **Based on** (file + reference PNG), the piece, Assumptions, Questions, checklist.

## Output format
1. **Based on:** spec + starter.
2. The code (HTML/CSS or framework requested) or the Figma frame.
3. **Assumptions** and **Questions** (always, even if short).
4. The checklist result.

# AGENTS.md

# AGENTS.md — Blue Roster Design System rules

> **Skill:** requests with `@BR_Legacy` follow `skills/BR_Legacy/SKILL.md` (see the end of this file).
> **Marketing (v6):** blueroster.com sections, the questionnaire landing and campaign banners follow `marketing/README.md` (section 11). They use the `mkt` layer (`tokens/marketing.css`, Inter), never the product `br-*` kit.

This file is the single source of rules for every AI coding agent (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, others) building Blue Roster UI. `CLAUDE.md` and `.cursor/rules/blueroster.mdc` point here. `.cursor/rules/blueroster-build.mdc` repeats the Playbook. Read this file, then `tokens/` (including `tokens/events.md` and `tokens/typography.md`), `patterns/`, `components/` and the relevant `screens/` spec (with its PNGs in `img/` and node tree in `json/`) before writing UI code. Requests that say **Blue Roster**, **Blue Roster Legacy**, or **BR** follow the Playbook at the end of this file.

Figma source: **Design System Legacy** — https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy (fileKey `k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq`).

## 1. Reuse, never redraw
- Build every screen from existing components. Look up `components/` first; if a `br-*`, `br-m-*` or `ms-*` component covers the need, use it.
- **Storybook is the source of truth for code.** The Angular `br-*` components in Storybook are what you import. Figma names match Storybook names (`br-button`, `br-input`, `br-table`, ...).
- Never re-implement a component with raw HTML/CSS. If something is genuinely missing, say so in the PR and propose a new component instead of inlining a one-off.

## 2. Tokens, not hex
- Every color, spacing, radius and typography value comes from `tokens/tokens.css` (CSS variables) or `tokens/tokens.json`.
- Prefer semantic `br/*` tokens (`--br-...`, including `br/event-*` for schedule events) over raw `mat/*` palette tokens.
- No hard-coded hex, rgb or px values where a token exists.

## 3. Light and Dark
- Every screen and component must work in both themes. Themes switch with `[data-theme="dark"]` on a root element; Light is the default (`:root`).
- Verify both themes before finishing.
- **Light and Dark side by side:** event tokens such as `--br-event-shift-neutral` are aliases (`var(--br-neutral-light)`). An alias resolves where it is declared, so if it only lived on `:root`, a `<div data-theme="dark">` inside a Light page kept the Light event colors. `tokens/tokens.css` now re-declares all 74 alias tokens on `[data-theme="light"], [data-theme="dark"]`, so `data-theme` works on any container out of the box. If you copy tokens into another file, keep that alias block (or use one iframe per theme).
- **Event block overflow (My Schedule Day, 3+ overlapping):** the title stays on one line with an ellipsis; the time line is hidden when the column is under 120 px wide or the event lasts 1 h (40 px tall); with 4+ overlapping events show 3 columns plus a `+N` pill (`br-m-event-more`) for the rest. `starter/br-m.css` and `starter/my-schedule-day.html` implement it (`is-compact` class).
- **Proposals (new, not in Legacy):** coverage holes (`--br-event-hole`, `br-event-hole`, `br-coverage-warning`) and Shift swap request cards live in `proposals/` and Figma page "Proposals · not in Legacy". Use them only when the user asks for coverage holes or shift swap, and label output "Proposal — new, not in Legacy".

## 4. Icons
- Use **Material Icons Outlined** only. Do not mix icon sets.

## 5. Platforms and layout
- **Employee app is mobile first** (390 wide reference; tablet 768 reference exists for Overtime). Desktop (1440) uses `br-app-shell` with `App=Employee`.
- **Admin app** is desktop web (1440×900) with `br-app-shell` `App=Admin`.
- App shell variants: `br-app-shell` → `App=Admin | Employee`. Employee sidebar: My Schedule, Overtime, Time Off, Sick Time, Logout. Mobile uses `br-m-app-bar` + `br-m-nav-drawer`.
- Page content components are named `br-content-<section>-<tab>` (e.g. `br-content-rosters-assignment`, `br-content-roster-catalogs-shift`). Follow that naming for new screens.
- Page header + tabs: `br-page-header` with `br-page-tab`.

## 6. Filter pattern
- **1–3 filters:** inline. On desktop they sit in **one row**.
- **4+ filters:** collapse them into a single dialog (`br-filter-dialog`, `Device=Mobile|Desktop`) opened by `br-filter-button` (shows a badge with the active filter count). One dialog for all filters, not one dialog per filter.
- Mobile dialog: full screen with Clear all / Apply pinned at the bottom. Desktop dialog: centered, 560 wide.

## 7. Calendars and dates
- Use **Mobiscroll** (`br-mobiscroll` and `br-mobiscroll-*`) for calendars, timelines, agenda and schedulers. Date inputs use `br-single-datepicker`, `br-range-datepicker`, `br-inline-datepicker` and the `br-linear-*-selector` components.

## 8. Tables, empty states, services
- Tables: `br-table` (+ `br-table-row`, `br-table-cell`, `br-table-header-cell`, `br-paginator`). Responsive data: `br-responsive-table`.
- Empty states: `br-empty-state-panel` (desktop) / `br-m-empty-state` (mobile).
- Dialogs, drawers, toasts and confirmations go through the services on the Figma *Services* page (dialog, drawer, confirmationDialogService, result dialog, toast). Do not hand-build modals.

## 9. Data honesty
- Text and numbers in Figma frames are illustrative. Do not copy them as real data, API fields or business rules.
- **Mockups may use sample data from `fixtures/`** (copied verbatim from the Figma frames and labelled sample). Use it for visual prototypes and mockups only; label it as sample data and never treat it as an API contract. Do not invent other data; if `fixtures/` has nothing that fits, reuse the closest sample and say so.
- Specs in `screens/` must not contain invented data or behavior. If a requirement is unknown, write "TBD" and ask.

## 9b. Match the Figma reference
- Each spec embeds Light and Dark PNGs exported from Figma (`screens/<group>/img/`). Compare your result against them before finishing.
- Event colors come from `tokens/events.md` (Shift = neutral gray `--br-event-shift-neutral`, Tasks = solid `--br-event-shift` with white text, Overtime `--br-event-overtime`, Planned overtime `--br-special-4`, Leave `--br-event-leave`).
- Day sample (`fixtures/schedule.json`, Thu 8 Oct 2026) now has all 5 event types: Shift, Tasks, Planned overtime 5–6 am, Leave 12–2 pm, Overtime 5–7 pm (placeholders reusing existing fixture text; range extended to 7 PM). Overlapping events go side by side in columns.
- Type is **Roboto** (see `tokens/typography.md`); icons are Material Icons Outlined.
- Time/date formats and copy: `patterns/formats.md` (12-hour `6 AM` labels, `Thu 8 Oct 2026`). Calendar geometry: `patterns/calendar-layout.md` (48px per hour, overlapping events side by side).
- Logo and avatar/badge specs: `assets/`. Never redraw the logo.
- For non-Angular mockups (Claude, Figma Make, plain HTML) start from `starter/` (`br-m.css`, `components.html`, `my-schedule-day.html`).

## 10. Known gaps (do not silently invent)
Loading / error / skeleton states, formal breakpoints, avatar initials variant (see `assets/README.md` for how the app bar draws it), `br-textarea` variant in `br-input`, no `br/event-planned-overtime` alias (the design uses `br/special-4`, see `tokens/events.md`), accent palette update, sticky behaviour of page header/tabs on My Schedule, multi-employee mobile calendar, unpublished Figma library. See README. When you hit one, flag it in your PR.

## 11. Marketing layer (website, landing, banners)
Requests about **marketing, banners, posts, LinkedIn/Instagram/Story, campaigns, the questionnaire landing, Wix or blueroster.com** follow `marketing/` instead of sections 1–9:
- Read `marketing/README.md`, then `marketing/foundations.md` and `tokens/marketing.md`; code uses `tokens/marketing.css` (`--mkt-*`, `.mkt-*`). Do not mix `--br-*` tokens or `br-*` components into marketing pages; product screenshots inside a marketing piece keep their own look.
- Landing: `marketing/landing.md` (`mkt-button`, `mkt-text-field`, `mkt-progress`, `mkt-option-card`, `mkt-result-card`, `mkt-step`, `mkt-select`, `mkt-checkbox`, flow, copy, Wix notes). Banners: `marketing/banners.md`. Examples: `marketing/references/`.
- Inter only: Black for display/H1 (and banner headlines), H2–H4 Semi Bold. Light page; Navy `#002458` only as a band (`[data-mkt-band="navy"]`), no Dark pages.
- Buttons: `#064DB7` + White on light (Manufacturing too); White `#F9F9F9` + Navy text inside Navy bands. `#1E75F6` is a non-text accent only. Orange `#F66C1E` is an accent only: Navy text on it, never white, never a button.
- Text contrast ≥ 4.5:1; check minimum sizes in every format.
- Approved stats only (per vertical, `marketing/banners.md`); never invent stats, quotes, testimonials, names or prices. Say "light version" (up to 50 users), never "free". Headlines verbatim from blueroster.com, sentence case + period. Links in the first comment. Market: US only.
- Unknowns stay `TBD`, exactly as for product work.

## Definition of done for UI work
- Uses existing components and tokens only (or flags the gap).
- Works in Light and Dark.
- Employee screens verified at 390 first, then desktop.
- Filter count follows the 1–3 / 4+ rule.
- Links the Figma node it implements in the PR description.

## Playbook

Follow this playbook when the request says **Blue Roster**, **Blue Roster Legacy**, or **BR**.

1. Read `AGENTS.md` and `tokens/` before writing UI (`tokens.css`, `tokens.json`, and the markdown tables).
2. Map the request to the closest spec in `screens/` and state which file you are following. Use the keyword table. If several rows match, pick one view and say why.
3. Build mobile first: **390**, then **768**, then **desktop**. Admin specs are drawn at 1440×900. If the chosen spec has no 390 or 768 frame, flag that gap instead of inventing a layout.
4. Colors use only `br/*` tokens, through the CSS variables in `tokens/tokens.css` (`--br-...`, slash becomes hyphen). Spacing, radius, and type use the variables in that same file (`--spacing`, `--radius-*`, `--text-*`, `--font-weight-*`). No hard-coded hex, rgb, or px where a token exists.
5. Use only components documented in `components/`. Calendars, timelines, agenda, and schedulers use Mobiscroll (`br-mobiscroll` and `br-mobiscroll-*`).
6. Filters: **1–3** stay inline (one row on desktop). **4+** go in one `br-filter-dialog`, opened by `br-filter-button`.
7. Deliver **Light and Dark**. Light is `:root`; Dark is `[data-theme="dark"]`.
8. Flag gaps instead of inventing components, tokens, states, copy, or behavior. Unknown items stay `TBD`.
9. Build **one view first** and ask for review before the next view.

### Keyword → spec

Keywords are request language. Each spec path is a file in `screens/`.

| Keywords | Spec |
|---|---|
| screen index, list of screens, qué pantallas | `screens/README.md` |
| marketing, mkt, website section, blueroster.com, Navy band | `marketing/foundations.md` + `tokens/marketing.css` (**marketing layer**, see section 11) |
| landing, questionnaire, cuestionario, Wix form, lead form | `marketing/landing.md` (**marketing layer**) |
| banner, post, LinkedIn, Instagram, Story, social, campaign, campaña, screen banner | `marketing/banners.md` + `marketing/references/` (**marketing layer**) |
| action center, action center live, centro de acción | `screens/admin/action-center.md` |
| action center requests, requests tab | `screens/admin/action-center-requests.md` |
| catalogs user, user catalog, usuarios | `screens/admin/catalogs-user.md` |
| gantt production, production schedule, producción | `screens/admin/gantt-production-schedule.md` |
| gantt, projection, gantt projection | `screens/admin/gantt.md` |
| history, assignment history, historial de asignaciones | `screens/admin/history-assignments.md` |
| roles, roles management | `screens/admin/roles.md` |
| base model, modelo base, roster catalogs base model | `screens/admin/roster-catalogs-base-model.md` |
| model catalog, roster catalogs model | `screens/admin/roster-catalogs-model.md` |
| pattern catalog, patrón, roster catalogs pattern | `screens/admin/roster-catalogs-pattern.md` |
| shift catalog, turno, roster catalogs shift | `screens/admin/roster-catalogs-shift.md` |
| rosters list, rosters tab | `screens/admin/rosters-rosters.md` |
| rosters assignment, assignment planning | `screens/admin/rosters.md` |
| sign in, login, iniciar sesión | `screens/admin/sign-in.md` |
| attendance, attendance today, asistencia, who is absent, quién faltó, ausencias hoy | `screens/admin/attendance-today.md` (approved, desktop 1440) |
| coverage hole, hueco, holes, cobertura | `proposals/coverage-holes.md` (**proposal**, not in Legacy) |
| shift swap, cambio de turno, intercambio de turno | `proposals/shift-swap.md` (**proposal**, not in Legacy) |
| workload engine | `screens/admin/workload-engine.md` |
| workload template, plantilla | `screens/admin/workload-template.md` |
| employee profile, perfil, profile desktop | `screens/employee-desktop/employee-profile-desktop.md` |
| my schedule desktop, agenda desktop, schedule desktop | `screens/employee-desktop/my-schedule-desktop-proposal.md` |
| overtime desktop, overtime filters desktop | `screens/employee-desktop/overtime-opportunities-desktop-filters.md` |
| avatar, language, notifications, nav drawer, idioma, notificaciones, menú | `screens/employee-mobile/global-overlays-avatar-menu-language-notifications-nav-drawer.md` |
| multi-employee calendar, team calendar on mobile, team schedule mobile, ver empleados en móvil, calendario de empleados móvil, calendario del equipo | **No spec yet. Stop and ask the user.** Offer `screens/admin/gantt.md` / `screens/admin/gantt-production-schedule.md` (desktop admin Gantt) as reference and the My Schedule mobile specs for styling; do not invent the layout. |
| agenda, schedule, my schedule, day, día, calendario | `screens/employee-mobile/my-schedule-day.md` |
| my schedule month, month, mes | `screens/employee-mobile/my-schedule-month.md` |
| my schedule week, week, semana | `screens/employee-mobile/my-schedule-week.md` |
| overtime approvals | `screens/employee-mobile/overtime-approvals.md` |
| overtime, overtime opportunities, horas extra | `screens/employee-mobile/overtime-opportunities.md` |
| sick time history, sick history | `screens/employee-mobile/sick-time-history.md` |
| sick time, sick request | `screens/employee-mobile/sick-time-request.md` |
| time off approvals | `screens/employee-mobile/time-off-approvals.md` |
| time off, time off request | `screens/employee-mobile/time-off-request.md` |

Marketing words (banner, post, landing, campaign, Wix, blueroster.com) win over product rows: "banner with My Schedule" maps to `marketing/banners.md`, not to the screen spec. Disambiguation: "agenda" or "my schedule" with no Day, Week, or Month, and no desktop, maps to `screens/employee-mobile/my-schedule-day.md`. "Overtime" with no Approvals maps to Opportunities. Desktop or Admin in the request wins over the mobile row. State the chosen spec before building.

"My schedule" means the signed-in employee's own calendar. A request to see **several employees** (team, crew, roster, empleados) on mobile has **no spec**: say so, ask, and offer the Gantt desktop spec as reference.

## @BR_Legacy skill (Codex and all agents)
When a request starts with **@BR_Legacy** (or says Blue Roster / BR), read and follow `skills/BR_Legacy/SKILL.md` before writing UI: closest spec → starter + PNG + spec → `--br-*` tokens and formats → reuse components → compose missing patterns with listed assumptions → self-check. Raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/skills/BR_Legacy/SKILL.md

Marketing requests (banner, post, landing, campaign, Wix, blueroster.com), with or without @BR_Legacy, follow the **Marketing mode** in `skills/BR_Legacy/SKILL.md` and `marketing/README.md`.

# tokens/radius.md

# Radius tokens

Generated from Figma variables (s2d). CSS var = `--` + name with `/` → `-`.

| Variable | Type | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|---|
| `radius/2xl` | number | 16 | 16 |
| `radius/lg` | number | 8 | 8 |
| `radius/md` | number | 6 | 6 |

# screens/employee-mobile/my-schedule-day.md

# My Schedule · Day

- **Platform:** Employee app · Mobile (390; tablet 768 where noted)
- **Shell:** `br-m-app-bar` + `br-m-nav-drawer`

## Designed states / frames
- **My Schedule · Day**: [Light](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=372-5392) 390×844 · [Dark](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=372-6394) 390×844

## Not designed yet
Loading, error, skeleton. Do not invent them silently; flag in the PR and follow README gaps.

## Event overflow (approved)

Applies when 3 or more events overlap in the Day timeline (width per column = (310 − 4 − 6·(n−1)) / n).

- **Title:** one line, ellipsis (`white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis`).
- **Time line:** hidden when the column is under 120 px wide (3 columns = 98 px) or the event lasts 1 h (40 px tall). Class `is-compact`.
- **4+ overlapping:** show 3 columns; the rest collapse into a `+N` pill (`br-m-event-more`, 20 tall, r10, padding 0 6, Roboto Medium 11, bg `--br-neutral-darkest`, text `--br-contrast`) at the top-right of the 3rd column. Tapping it opens the day agenda (TBD).

# screens/admin/attendance-today.md

# Attendance Today (Admin) — approved

- **Status:** Approved pattern (Oct 2026). Previously "Composed pattern — pending design approval".
- **Figma:** [Light](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=497-14593) · [Dark](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=497-14900) (Screens page)
- **Platform:** Admin web app, desktop 1440×900, `br-app-shell` App=Admin, page title "Attendance Today" (no tabs, no primary button)
- **Content component:** `br-content-attendance-today` ([497:4887](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=497-4887), Toolkit page)
- **Starter:** `starter/admin-attendance-today.html` · **Sample data:** `fixtures/admin.json` → `attendance`

## Purpose
Who is working, late or absent today, with each person's roster for the day.

## Layout (content 1144 wide, padding 16, gap 16, bg `--br-contrast`)
1. **Summary row:** date "Thu 8 Oct 2026" (Roboto Medium 16) + 3 `br-m-status-pill` with counts: "Working 3", "Late 1", "Absent 2".
2. **Legend:** `br-m-legend` (Shift · Tasks · Overtime · Planned overtime · Leave).
3. **`br-table`** (r8, 1px `--br-component-border`): header row of `br-table-header-cell` (EMPLOYEE 120 · POSITION 90 · SHIFT 160 · TIME 140 · STATUS 110 · roster hours 5 AM–7 PM every 2 h). Rows 52 tall, 1px `--br-divider`: `br-table-cell` Text (employee), Text secondary (position, shift, time), status pill, roster track.
4. **Roster track:** 14 h × 32 px, `br-m-event-block` 36 tall, all 5 event types; overflow rule from My Schedule Day (title ellipsis, time hidden under 120 px or at 1 h).

## Status pills
| Status | Pill variant | Token | Icon |
|---|---|---|---|
| Working | Approved | `--br-semantic1` | check_circle |
| Late | Pending | `--br-semantic3` | schedule |
| Absent | Rejected | `--br-semantic2` | cancel |

## States
- Designed: Default (Light, Dark). Not designed: loading, error, empty, filters, row tap detail (TBD).

# proposals/coverage-holes.md

# B · Coverage holes — Proposal (new, not in Legacy)

A **hole** is a line/position with no one covering it for a time range (e.g. a leave or swap request removes the only person).

## Token
`--br-event-hole` (Figma `br/event-hole`): Light → `--br-semantic3-3`, Dark → `--br-semantic3-2`. Declared in `tokens/tokens.css` (marked PROPOSAL).

## Components (Figma page "Proposals · not in Legacy")
- **`br-event-hole`** ([498:910](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=498-910)): same geometry as `br-m-event-block` (padding 6/8, r4), bg `--br-event-hole`, 1px dashed `--br-semantic3`, `warning` icon 16 `--br-semantic3`, title Roboto Medium 12 + time 11 `--br-neutral-darkest`. Props: Title, Time. CSS: `.br-event-hole`.
- **`br-coverage-warning`** ([498:915](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=498-915)): banner, bg `--br-semantic3-3`, 1px `--br-semantic3`, r8, padding 12/16, `warning` 20 + copy Roboto Medium 14: **"This request will leave a hole in Line 1, Position 1"**. CSS: `.br-coverage-warning`. Shown on a request (time off, sick time, shift swap) before approving.
- **Action Center · Live view · coverage** ([498:37452](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=498-37452)): 1144 content; header "Thu 8 Oct 2026 · Live view · 2 coverage holes", warning banner, hours 5 AM–7 PM (56 px/h), one lane per Line · Position (52 tall, label 160). Two holes: Line 1 · Position 1 (6 am–4 pm) and Line 2 · Position 2 (6–10 am).

## Open questions
Who can fill a hole (overtime offer?), whether holes appear on employee mobile, and the exact rule that defines a hole.

# marketing/README.md

# Blue Roster Marketing design system

Everything an AI needs to replicate Blue Roster **marketing** output: blueroster.com sections, the questionnaire landing (Wix) and campaign banners. It is a separate layer from the product (Legacy) kit: product screens follow `AGENTS.md`, `tokens/tokens.css` and `components/`; marketing follows this folder.

| File | What |
|---|---|
| [foundations.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/marketing/foundations.md) | Colors (Light page + Navy band modes), 20 `mkt` text styles, 4 grid styles, section spacing, and the 6 approved decisions. |
| [../tokens/marketing.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/tokens/marketing.css) | `--mkt-*` CSS variables and `.mkt-*` helpers (v0.5). Import on marketing pages only. |
| [../tokens/marketing.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/tokens/marketing.md) | Full token tables, primitives, sources, contrast and changelog (v0.5). |
| [landing.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/marketing/landing.md) | Questionnaire landing: `mkt-*` components, frames, flow, copy, rules and the Wix build notes. |
| [banners.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/marketing/banners.md) | Campaign banners: formats, families, styling, system-screen banners, approved stats, compliance checklist. |
| [references/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/marketing/references/README.md) | Approved reference PNGs: 3 Light screen captures and 6 banners. |

## Keyword → file

| Keywords | Read |
|---|---|
| marketing, mkt, website section, blueroster.com, Inter, Navy band | `marketing/foundations.md` + `tokens/marketing.css` |
| landing, questionnaire, cuestionario, Wix, form, lead form | `marketing/landing.md` |
| banner, post, LinkedIn, Instagram, Story, social, campaign, campaña | `marketing/banners.md` + `marketing/references/` |
| screen banner, banner with screens, mockup with app screens | `marketing/banners.md` → "Banners with system screens" |

## Ten rules (summary)

1. Inter only; Black for display/H1 and banner headlines, H2–H4 Semi Bold. Product screenshots keep Roboto.
2. Light page; Navy `#002458` only as a band (`[data-mkt-band="navy"]`). No Dark pages.
3. Primary CTA `#064DB7` + White on light; White `#F9F9F9` + Navy text on Navy.
4. `#1E75F6` and vertical accents are non-text; text uses `text/*` or `vertical/*/text`.
5. Orange `#F66C1E`: accent only, Navy text on it, never white, never a button.
6. Text contrast ≥ 4.5:1; check minimum sizes in every format.
7. Approved stats only, per vertical. Never invent stats, quotes, testimonials, names or prices.
8. Say "light version" (up to 50 users), never "free". All 3 landing options for everyone.
9. Headlines verbatim from blueroster.com, sentence case + period. Links in the first comment.
10. Market is US only. Unknowns stay `TBD`; flag gaps instead of inventing.

# marketing/foundations.md

# Marketing foundations (`mkt`)

Source: Figma **Design System Legacy** (`k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq`) → page **Marketing · Foundations** ([561:21](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=561-21)), docs board [566:80](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=566-80). Read from Figma on 2026-10-19 (read-only). Tokens version: **v0.5**.

Code: [`../tokens/marketing.css`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/tokens/marketing.css) (CSS variables) · full value tables, sources and contrast: [`../tokens/marketing.md`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/tokens/marketing.md).

The marketing layer sits **next to** the product kit, never inside it. Product screens keep `tokens/tokens.css` (`--br-*`), Roboto and the `br-*` components. Marketing pages (blueroster.com, the questionnaire landing) and campaign banners use `--mkt-*`, Inter and the `mkt-*` components. Product screenshots placed inside a marketing piece keep their own Roboto/`--br-*` look.

## Decisions (approved, Figma block [566:94](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=566-94))

| # | Decision | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Hero **display stays 80 px at 1440** (mobile 48 px). | István 2026-10-18 |
| 2 | **H2 is Inter Semi Bold (600)** on desktop and mobile. **Black (900) only for display and H1.** H3 and H4 are Semi Bold, so no heading below H2 is heavier than H2. | István 2026-10-18 |
| 3 | **No Dark pages.** The `mkt` collection has two modes: **Light** (the page) and **Navy band** (only for content inside Navy `#002458` sections: CTA band, stat band, confirmation, footer). | István 2026-10-18 |
| 4 | **Manufacturing buttons use `#064DB7`** (`vertical/mfg/accent-strong`, 7.25:1 with white text). **`#1E75F6` is the Mfg accent for non-text elements only** (icons, illustration, highlights, dots, charts). Never 16 px white text on `#1E75F6` (4.05:1). | István 2026-10-18 |
| 5 | **Primary button inside a Navy band** (any vertical) is **White `#F9F9F9` with Navy `#002458` text** (14.32:1). Tokens `action/primary` + `action/on-primary`. | István 2026-10-18 |
| 6 | **Secondary accent orange `#F66C1E`** (Matz Styleguide "Secondary/Default", ramp `#903502` → `#FFCDB1`). **Text on orange is only Navy `#002458`** (5.08:1), **never white** (2.97:1). Orange is never a button and never the only signal for meaning. Orange-colored text uses `orange/900` `#903502`. `#FF6B35` is dropped. | Matz 2026-10-19 |

Nothing is pending in the Foundations decisions. Line heights, mobile sizes, eyebrow, grid and spacing values are still **proposals** (usable, but flag them if you change them).

## 1. Colors: collection `mkt` (modes Light / Navy band)

Brand base: Navy `#002458`, Blue `#1E75F6`, Blue Light `#C7DDFD`, White `#F9F9F9`, Dark `#111827`. Vertical accents: Manufacturing `#1E75F6`, Healthcare `#14B8A6`, Logistics `#BA7517`, Generic `#9CA3AF`.

CSS: Light is the default on `:root`. Wrap anything placed on a Navy section in `[data-mkt-band="navy"]` (or `.mkt-band-navy`); every value re-resolves inside it.

### Neutral and action tokens

| Token | CSS variable | Light page | Navy band |
|---|---|---|---|
| `surface/page` | `--mkt-surface-page` | `#F9F9F9` | `#002458` |
| `surface/raised` | `--mkt-surface-raised` | `#FFFFFF` | `#143565` |
| `surface/inverse` | `--mkt-surface-inverse` | `#002458` | `#F9F9F9` |
| `text/heading` | `--mkt-text-heading` | `#002458` | `#F9F9F9` |
| `text/body` | `--mkt-text-body` | `#111827` | `#C7DDFD` |
| `text/muted` | `--mkt-text-muted` | `#535353` | `#8EBAFA` |
| `text/on-inverse` | `--mkt-text-on-inverse` | `#F9F9F9` | `#002458` |
| `border/default` | `--mkt-border-default` | `#D1D5DB` | `#324F78` |
| `action/primary` | `--mkt-action-primary` | `#064DB7` | `#F9F9F9` |
| `action/on-primary` | `--mkt-action-on-primary` | `#F9F9F9` | `#002458` |
| `accent/secondary` | `--mkt-accent-secondary` | `#F66C1E` | `#F66C1E` |
| `accent/on-secondary` | `--mkt-accent-on-secondary` | `#002458` | `#002458` |

### Vertical tokens (`vertical/<mfg|health|logistics|generic>/<role>`)

Roles: `accent` (decorative fills, illustration, highlights) · `accent-strong` (filled buttons, badges, selected cards, meaningful icons) · `on-accent` (text on `accent-strong`) · `tint` (soft background, selected option card) · `text` (accent-colored text, ≥4.5:1 on surface and tint).

| Vertical | accent | accent-strong (Light / Navy) | on-accent (Light / Navy) | tint (Light / Navy) | text (Light / Navy) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Manufacturing | `#1E75F6` | `#064DB7` / `#F9F9F9` | `#F9F9F9` / `#002458` | `#C7DDFD` / `#063478` | `#064DB7` / `#8EBAFA` |
| Healthcare | `#14B8A6` | `#13726E` / `#14B8A6` | `#F9F9F9` / `#002458` | `#CBECE8` / `#044268` | `#13726E` / `#26BDAD` |
| Logistics | `#BA7517` | `#87591C` / `#C89249` | `#F9F9F9` / `#002458` | `#ECDFCC` / `#25344B` | `#87591C` / `#C89249` |
| Generic | `#9CA3AF` | `#5F6673` / `#9CA3AF` | `#F9F9F9` / `#002458` | `#E6E8EA` / `#1F3D69` | `#5F6673` / `#A2A8B3` |

On the Light page Health `#14B8A6` (2.36:1) and Generic `#9CA3AF` (2.41:1) are below 3:1: decorative areas only; use `accent-strong` for icons, borders, focus rings and text. Primitives (31 values in `mkt · primitives`) and the full contrast table are in [`../tokens/marketing.md`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/tokens/marketing.md).

## 2. Typography: 20 text styles (`mkt/desktop/*` + `mkt/mobile/*`)

Family **Inter** (Regular 400, Semi Bold 600, Bold 700, Black 900). Desktop styles apply at ≥1024 px, mobile below 1024 (designed at 390). CSS: `.mkt-<role>` classes and `--mkt-font-<role>-{size,line-height,letter-spacing,weight}`, which switch at `min-width: 1024px`. Values below are read from the Figma text styles.

| Role | Weight | Desktop (size / LH / tracking) | Mobile (size / LH / tracking) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `display` | Black | 80 / 105% / −2.5px | 48 / 110% / −1.5px |
| `h1` | Black | 44 / 110% / −2.5px | 36 / 110% / −1.5px |
| `h2` | Semi Bold | 34 / 115% / −1.5px | 28 / 120% / −1px |
| `h3` | Semi Bold | 24 / 120% / −0.5px | 22 / 120% / −0.5px |
| `h4` | Semi Bold | 20 / 130% / 0 | 18 / 130% / 0 |
| `eyebrow` (UPPERCASE) | Bold | 14 / 140% / +1.5px | 12 / 140% / +1.2px |
| `lead` | Regular | 22 / 140% / 0 | 18 / 140% / 0 |
| `body` | Regular | 16 / 140% / 0 | 16 / 140% / 0 |
| `small` | Regular | 14 / 140% / 0 | 14 / 140% / 0 |
| `button` | Bold | 16 / 125% / 0 | 16 / 125% / 0 |

Rules: Black only for `display` and `h1` · H2–H4 Semi Bold · eyebrow and button Bold · no Light/ExtraLight headlines. Wix theme mapping is in [`landing.md`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/marketing/landing.md#wix-theme-site-styles).

## 3. Grid: 4 grid styles (`mkt/grid/*`) and collection `mkt · layout`

| Breakpoint | Range | Columns | Gutter | Side margin | Content measure | Figma grid style |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1440 | ≥ 1440 | 12 | 24 | 80 | 720 | `mkt/grid/1440` |
| 1024 | 1024–1439 | 12 | 24 | 48 | 720 | `mkt/grid/1024` |
| 768 | 768–1023 | 8 | 24 | 40 | 688 | `mkt/grid/768` |
| 390 | < 768 | 4 | 16 | 20 | 350 | `mkt/grid/390` |

Container max width **1280** (`--mkt-container-max`), centred. Text measure max **720** (`--mkt-content-measure`). Grid variables: `--mkt-grid-columns`, `--mkt-grid-gutter`, `--mkt-grid-margin`. 390 / 768 / 1440 match the Legacy reference frames; 1024 is new. (Proposal.)

## 4. Spacing: section scale (4 px base)

| Token | CSS variable | 1440 | 1024 | 768 | 390 | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `section/xs` | `--mkt-section-xs` | 32 | 32 | 24 | 24 | small stacks |
| `section/sm` | `--mkt-section-sm` | 48 | 48 | 40 | 32 | heading → content |
| `section/md` | `--mkt-section-md` | 64 | 64 | 56 | 48 | inside a section |
| `section/lg` | `--mkt-section-lg` | 96 | 80 | 72 | 64 | between sections |
| `section/xl` | `--mkt-section-xl` | 128 | 112 | 96 | 80 | hero top / final CTA |

Component-level spacing uses the Legacy 4 px base (`--spacing`). (Proposal.)

## 5. Quick rules for any marketing output

- Light page by default. Navy appears only as a **band** (`[data-mkt-band="navy"]`), never as a full dark theme. One Navy band per landing page (the confirmation).
- Primary CTA: `--mkt-action-primary` + `--mkt-action-on-primary` (Light `#064DB7`/White, Navy band White/Navy). Mfg uses the same `#064DB7` on light.
- `#1E75F6` and the vertical `accent` colors are for non-text elements; text uses `text/*` or `vertical/*/text`.
- Orange `#F66C1E`: highlights and illustration accessories only (e.g. the blue men vest); Navy text on it, never white; never a button.
- Contrast: text ≥ 4.5:1 (≥ 3:1 only for large text ≥ 24 px, or 18.66 px bold), UI control edges and meaningful graphics ≥ 3:1.
- Known gaps: no error/feedback token (the landing uses literal `#B42318`), no `border/strong` token (field edges use `text/muted`).

# tokens/marketing.md

# Marketing foundations (`mkt`) · v0.5

Status: five decisions approved by István (art direction) on 2026-10-18 and the orange accent decided by Matz on 2026-10-19; the remaining proposals are still open. This is the marketing layer for the questionnaire landing and other blueroster.com pages. It sits **next to** the product kit and never inside it: `tokens.css` (s2d), `br/*` variables and `br-*` components are untouched.

- Figma: *Design System Legacy* → page **Marketing · Foundations** ([561:21](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=561-21)), docs board [566:80](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=566-80)
  - Sections: [Decisions 566:94](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=566-94) (decision 5: [568:23](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=568-23), decision 6: [588:11856](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=588-11856)) · [Type 566:109](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=566-109) · [Grid 567:21](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=567-21) · [Spacing 567:81](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=567-81) · [Colors 568:26](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=568-26) (Light page [568:30](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=568-30), Navy band [568:165](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=568-165)) · [Orange accent 568:300](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=568-300)
  - Variable collections: `mkt · primitives` (1 mode), `mkt` (**Light** / **Navy band**), `mkt · layout` (1440 / 1024 / 768 / 390)
  - Styles: `mkt/desktop/*`, `mkt/mobile/*` (Inter text styles) and `mkt/grid/1440|1024|768|390` (grid styles)
- CSS: [`tokens/marketing.css`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/tokens/marketing.css). Import it on marketing pages only. Light is the default on `:root`. Wrap Navy sections in `[data-mkt-band="navy"]` (or `.mkt-band-navy`).

## Decisions: **Approved by István 2026-10-18**

| # | Decision | Where it lands |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Hero **display stays at 80 px at 1440**. Mobile stays at 48 px (0.6×; no change needed). | `mkt/desktop/display`, `mkt/mobile/display`, `--mkt-font-display-size` |
| 2 | **H2 is Inter Semi Bold (600)** on desktop and mobile. **Black only for display and H1.** H3 and H4 were lowered to Semi Bold, so no heading below H2 is heavier than H2. | `mkt/*/h2`, `h3`, `h4` |
| 3 | **No Dark pages.** The second `mkt` mode is renamed **Navy band** and is used only for content inside Navy `#002458` sections. | collection `mkt`, `[data-mkt-band="navy"]` |
| 4 | **Manufacturing buttons use `#064DB7`** (`vertical/mfg/accent-strong`, 7.25:1 with white text). **`#1E75F6` stays the Mfg accent** for non-text elements (icons, illustration, highlights, dots, charts). Do not put 16 px white text on `#1E75F6` (4.05:1). | `vertical/mfg/accent`, `vertical/mfg/accent-strong` |
| 5 | **Primary buttons inside a Navy band** (Manufacturing and any vertical) are **White `#F9F9F9` with Navy `#002458` text: 14.32:1** (button vs band edge also 14.32:1). This replaces the `#6EA3FF` proposal. `#1E75F6` stays the accent for non-text elements. | `action/primary`, `action/on-primary`, `vertical/mfg/accent-strong` (Navy band), `.mkt-button-primary` |
| 6 | **Secondary accent orange is `#F66C1E`**, from Matz's Styleguide "Secondary/Default" (ramp `#903502` → `#FFCDB1`). Text on it is **Navy `#002458` (5.08:1), never white** (2.97:1). `#FF6B35` is dropped. **Decided by Matz 2026-10-19.** | `accent/secondary`, `accent/on-secondary`, `orange/*`, `.mkt-accent-secondary` |

Nothing pending in Foundations decisions.

## Status labels

| Label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **approved** | Decided by art direction (István), with date |
| **sourced** | Taken as-is from `context.md`, the blueroster.com Wix theme CSS, or the Legacy product tokens |
| **derived** | Computed from a sourced value with the stated formula |
| **proposal** | Alex's judgment; still needs approval |
| **pending** | Decision open; no token created |

## 1. Type: Inter

Font family: **Inter**, in Regular 400, Semi Bold 600, Bold 700 and Black 900. Weight rule (**Approved by István 2026-10-18**): **Black only for display and H1**; H2–H4 are Semi Bold; eyebrow and button are Bold. Product screenshots inside mockups keep Roboto.

Site conversion: the Wix theme sizes headings in `spx` at a 1802 px design width (`--theme-spx-ratio: var(--scaling-factor) / 1802`), so a Wix size N = `N × viewport / 1802`. The desktop values below are the 1440 equivalents (×0.8). Desktop styles apply at ≥1024; mobile styles below 1024 (designed at 390).

| Role | Weight | Desktop size / LH / tracking | Mobile size / LH / tracking | Source / status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `display` | Black | 80 / 105% / -2.5px | 48 / 110% / -1.5px | 80px at 1440: Approved by István 2026-10-18. Source: blueroster.com Wix theme font_0 = Inter Black 100spx at the 1802 design width, which is 80px at 1440 (Wix scales ×W/1802). Weight and −2.5px: context.md. Mobile 48 (0.6× desktop, same step as H1 44→36 relative to the 390 column): proposal, kept. Line height: proposal. |
| `h1` | Black | 44 / 110% / -2.5px | 36 / 110% / -1.5px | Size: site font_2 (H2 role) Inter Black 55spx, 44px at 1440. Weight and −2.5px: context.md. Line height and mobile: proposal. |
| `h2` | Semi Bold | 34 / 115% / -1.5px | 28 / 120% / -1px | Size and weight: site font_6 Inter Semi Bold 42spx, 33.6px at 1440, rounded to 34. Semi Bold: Approved by István 2026-10-18 (Black only for display and H1). Letter spacing, line height and mobile: proposal. |
| `h3` | Semi Bold | 24 / 120% / -0.5px | 22 / 120% / -0.5px | Size: site font_4 24px (fixed px). Weight lowered from Black to Semi Bold so it is never heavier than H2 (Approved by István 2026-10-18). Line height (site 1em), letter spacing and mobile: proposal. |
| `h4` | Semi Bold | 20 / 130% / 0px | 18 / 130% / 0px | Size: proposal. Weight Semi Bold so it is never heavier than H2 (Approved by István 2026-10-18). |
| `eyebrow` (UPPER) | Bold | 14 / 140% / 1.5px | 12 / 140% / 1.2px | Proposal. Inter Bold uppercase; 14px is the most common inline size on the site. |
| `lead` | Regular | 22 / 140% / 0px | 18 / 140% / 0px | Desktop: site font_8 (Body M) Inter Regular 22spx, 1.4em. Mobile: proposal. |
| `body` | Regular | 16 / 140% / 0px | 16 / 140% / 0px | Site font_7 (Body L) Inter Regular 16px. Line height 1.4em is the site default. |
| `small` | Regular | 14 / 140% / 0px | 14 / 140% / 0px | 14px: the most common inline font-size on blueroster.com. Line height 1.4em is the site default. |
| `button` | Bold | 16 / 125% / 0px | 16 / 125% / 0px | Site font_5 Inter Bold 16px. Line height 1.25: proposal. |

Figma style names: `mkt/desktop/<role>` and `mkt/mobile/<role>`. CSS: `.mkt-<role>` classes plus `--mkt-font-<role>-{size,line-height,letter-spacing,weight}`, which switch at `min-width: 1024px`.

Site reference (Wix theme, at the 1802 design width): font_0 Inter Black 100 · font_2 (H2) Black 55 · font_3 (H3) Black 52 · font_4 (H4) Black 24px · font_5 (H5) Bold 16px · font_6 (H6) Semi Bold 42 · font_7 (Body L) Regular 16px/1.25 · font_8 (Body M) Regular 22 · font_9 (Body S) Regular 19 · font_10 DIN Next Light 12px.

## 3. Color: collection `mkt` (Light page / Navy band)

**Modes ({A}):** `Light` is the page. `Navy band` is **not a dark theme**: use it only for content placed inside a Navy `#002458` section, such as a CTA band, a stat band or the footer. In that mode, `surface/page` resolves to Navy.

### Vertical roles

| Role | Use |
|---|---|
| `accent` | Brand accent: decorative fills, illustration, highlights, icons where ≥3:1. **Mfg = `#1E75F6` in both modes ({A})** |
| `accent-strong` | Filled buttons, badges, selected option cards, icons that convey meaning. **Mfg Light = `#064DB7` ({A})** |
| `on-accent` | Text and icons on `accent-strong` |
| `tint` | Soft background (option card hover/selected, section band) |
| `text` | Accent-colored text on the surface **and** on `tint` (≥4.5:1 on both) |

| Token | Light page | Navy band |
|---|---|---|

### Primary action ({A})

| Token | Light page | Navy band | Contrast |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action/primary` | `#064DB7` | `#F9F9F9` | edge vs surface: 7.25:1 / 14.32:1 |
| `action/on-primary` | `#F9F9F9` | `#002458` | text: 7.25:1 / 14.32:1 |

Use `action/primary` for the main CTA button on any page or band. Inside a Navy band, every primary button is White with Navy text, whatever the vertical; `vertical/*/accent-strong` stays available for badges and selected states. `#064DB7` is not used in Navy bands (1.98:1 against `#002458`).

|---|---|---|---|

| `teal/700` | `#13726E` | derived | mix 44% #111827 into #14B8A6 until >=4.5:1 on #F9F9F9 and on teal/100 |
| `teal/100` | `#CBECE8` | derived | mix 20% #14B8A6 into #F9F9F9 |
| `teal/navy-tint` | `#044268` | derived | mix 20% #14B8A6 into #002458 |
| `ochre/500` | `#BA7517` | sourced | context.md Logistics accent |

| `ochre/700` | `#87591C` | derived | mix 30% #111827 into #BA7517 until >=4.5:1 on #F9F9F9 and on ochre/100 |
| `ochre/100` | `#ECDFCC` | derived | mix 20% #BA7517 into #F9F9F9 |
| `ochre/navy-tint` | `#25344B` | derived | mix 20% #BA7517 into #002458 |
| `gray/400` | `#9CA3AF` | sourced | context.md Generic accent |
| `gray/350` | `#A2A8B3` | derived | mix 6% #F9F9F9 into #9CA3AF until >=4.5:1 on #002458 and on gray/navy-tint |
| `gray/700` | `#5F6673` | derived | mix 44% #111827 into #9CA3AF until >=4.5:1 on #F9F9F9 and on gray/100 |
| `gray/100` | `#E6E8EA` | derived | mix 20% #9CA3AF into #F9F9F9 |
| `gray/navy-tint` | `#1F3D69` | derived | mix 20% #9CA3AF into #002458 |
| `orange/900` | `#903502` | sourced | Matz Styleguide, Secondary ramp darkest. 7.4:1 on #F9F9F9: the only orange for text |
| `orange/500` | `#F66C1E` | sourced | Matz Styleguide "Secondary/Default" (= Legacy br/illustration-secondary, blueroster.com color_23). Decided by Matz 2026-10-19 |
| `orange/100` | `#FFCDB1` | sourced | Matz Styleguide, Secondary ramp lightest |

`mix(a, b, t)` is a linear sRGB blend of t·a + (1−t)·b. Text shades step t in 2 % increments until WCAG 2.x reaches ≥4.5:1 on the surface and on the tint. Tints are 20 % accent mixed into White (Light) or Navy (Navy band). The Manufacturing Light tint is the sourced Blue Light `#C7DDFD`.

### Contrast (WCAG 2.x)

| Mode | Vertical | on-accent / accent-strong | text / surface | text / tint | accent / surface (graphics ≥3) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Light | Manufacturing | 7.25 | 7.25 | 5.52 | 4.05 |
| Light | Healthcare | 5.45 | 5.45 | 4.56 | 2.36 ⚠️ |
| Light | Logistics | 5.74 | 5.74 | 4.6 | 3.53 |
| Light | Generic | 5.49 | 5.49 | 4.7 | 2.41 ⚠️ |
| Navy band | Manufacturing | 14.32 | 7.58 | 5.96 | 3.54 |
| Navy band | Healthcare | 6.06 | 6.43 | 4.52 | 6.06 |
| Navy band | Logistics | 5.5 | 5.5 | 4.58 | 4.05 |
| Navy band | Generic | 5.94 | 6.31 | 4.55 | 5.94 |

⚠️ On the Light page, Health `#14B8A6` (2.36:1) and Generic `#9CA3AF` (2.41:1) are below 3:1. Use them only for large decorative areas and illustration; use `accent-strong` for icons, borders, focus rings and text.

### Orange accent: **decided by Matz 2026-10-19**

| Token | Light page | Navy band | Contrast |
|---|---|---|---|
| `accent/secondary` | `#F66C1E` | `#F66C1E` | vs `#F9F9F9` 2.82:1 ⚠️ · vs `#002458` 5.08:1 |
| `accent/on-secondary` | `#002458` | `#002458` | Navy on orange 5.08:1 ✅ · white on orange 2.97:1 ❌ |

- Source: Matz's Styleguide (Figma `DAuBM7JWL76akz6WcfnbZ4`, node 1:2), "Secondary/Default" `#F66C1E`, ramp `#903502` → `#FFCDB1`. The Styleguide also confirms `#064DB7` as Primary/Dark.
- Use for highlights, badges and illustration accessories (e.g. the blue men vest). It is below 3:1 on the page bg, so never the only signal for meaning, and **never a button**.
- Any text on orange is Navy (`accent/on-secondary`), **never white**. For orange-colored text use `orange/900` `#903502` (7.4:1 on `#F9F9F9`).
- `#FF6B35` (Blue men character sheet v1.0) is not in the Styleguide and is dropped.

## Changelog
- **v0.5 (2026-10-19):** decision 6 (Matz): orange accent `#F66C1E`. Added primitives `orange/900`, `orange/500`, `orange/100`, semantic `accent/secondary` + `accent/on-secondary` (Navy), and the `.mkt-accent-secondary` helper. Figma: Orange panel 568:300 now shows the token, decision 6 added to the Decisions block. (v0.4 was not packaged.)
- **v0.3 (2026-10-18):** decision 5: Navy band primary button is White `#F9F9F9` + Navy text (14.32:1). Added `action/primary` and `action/on-primary`, set `vertical/mfg/accent-strong` (Navy band) to White, removed the unused primitive `blue/300` `#6EA3FF`, and added the `.mkt-button-primary` helper.
- **v0.2 (2026-10-18):** applied István's decisions 1–4. H2–H4 are now Semi Bold. The Dark mode became Navy band, with values re-derived against Navy and Dark-only primitives removed. Documented the Mfg `#064DB7` / `#1E75F6` split. CSS: Navy band selector `[data-mkt-band="navy"]` replaces `[data-theme="dark"]`, and Inter 600 is added to the font import.
- **v0.1 (2026-10-18):** first draft.

## Open questions
1. The remaining proposals (line heights, mobile sizes, eyebrow, grid, spacing) are still waiting for approval.

# marketing/landing.md

# Questionnaire landing (Wix)

Figma: **Design System Legacy** → page **Marketing · Questionnaire landing** ([570:21](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=570-21)) · Read me [577:40287](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=577-40287) · components frame "Components · mkt landing" [570:22](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=570-22).
Built with [`foundations.md`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/marketing/foundations.md) (mkt v0.5) and the `br-blue-men` poses (Raising hand, Standing thinking, Arms up, Waving). State: v0.1, final decisions by Matz 2026-10-19. Copy: Hemmingway v3 / v3.1.

Funnel: social post → this single-scroll questionnaire landing → one of 3 next steps (learn more · book a demo · try the light version). Every answer lands in a Google Sheet for sales.

## Hard rules

1. **Market: United States only** (Matz, 2026-10-19). The Country field is a dropdown: **United States** (default) · **Other** ("Other" shows a short text field by a Wix Rule). Mexico is removed; no other countries, no Spanish version.
2. **All 3 options for everyone**, any company size. No size cutoff and no Rule depends on company size. The employee ranges (1–49 · 50–200 · 201–500 · 500+) are data for sales only.
3. **Light version**: open to any company, allows **up to 50 users** in the system. Option helper (helper style, `mkt/small`, `text/muted`): **"Up to 50 users."** Always say "light version", never "free" (no pricing anywhere).
4. **Demo**: option text **"A 20–45 minute demo."**
5. **Industry rule**: only Manufacturing, Healthcare and Logistics (they have their own page) carry "for [industry]". Food & beverage, Retail, Security & facilities and Other go to the general page and drop it (table below).
6. **Consent lines** (Hemmingway, privacy policy draft):
   - Checkbox A, **required** when `next_step` = demo or light: "Blue Roster can email me about my request and related product updates. I can unsubscribe anytime."
   - Notice under it, always shown, helper style (`mkt/small` 14, `text/muted` `#535353`): "We use your answers to reply to your request and follow up about Blue Roster. Details in our Privacy Policy." ("Privacy Policy" links to the policy page, URL TBD.)
   - Checkbox B, **optional, unchecked by default**: "Blue Roster can call or text me at the number above, including with automated technology, about its products. Consent isn't required to buy anything. Reply STOP to opt out." Keep it only if sales will call/text (pending client); stored as its own column `consent_call_text`.
7. No testimonials, no prices, no logos other than `br-logo`. Approved stats only (see [`banners.md`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/marketing/banners.md#approved-stats-only)). Orange `#F66C1E` is not used in the form UI.
8. Hero: **"See your schedule run itself."** (option A, decided by Matz).

## Components (`mkt-*`, frame 570:22)

All bind to `mkt` variables and `mkt/*` text styles. Never use `br-*` product components on marketing pages.

| Component | Node | Props / variants | Anatomy and tokens |

Primary fill `action/primary` + label `action/on-primary` (Light `#064DB7`/`#F9F9F9` 7.25:1, Navy band `#F9F9F9`/`#002458` 14.32:1). Secondary = 1.5 px outline `action/primary`. Tertiary = text link, no padding. CSS helper `.mkt-button-primary`. |

## Flow and copy (one Wix Form, 5 pages)

**Hero (D0/M0).** Headline **"See your schedule run itself."** · Sub "Tell us how your shifts run. Five quick steps, then pick what's next." · CTA **Start** (scrolls to / opens the form) · blue man illustration. Header = logo only; no header CTA, so every demo request goes through the form.

**Step 1 of 5 · Your industry.** "What industry are you in?" (required, single choice): Manufacturing · Healthcare · Logistics & warehousing · Food & beverage · Retail · Security & facilities · Other [short text].

**Step 2 of 5 · Your company.** Company name (required) · "How many employees do you schedule?" (required) 1–49 · 50–200 · 201–500 · 500+ · "How many sites?" (required) 1 · 2–5 · 6+ · "Do you run 24/7?" (optional) Yes · No · **Country** (required, dropdown): **United States** (default) · Other [short text by Rule].

**Step 3 of 5 · Your team.** "What roles do your people work?" (required, multi; shown by industry):
- Manufacturing: Line operators · Machine operators · Maintenance · Quality · Supervisors
- Healthcare: RNs · CNAs · Techs · Support staff · Supervisors
- Logistics: Pickers & packers · Forklift operators · Drivers · Supervisors
- Food, Retail, Security, Other: Hourly staff · Shift leads · Supervisors · Other

"Which certifications do you check before a shift?" (optional): OSHA · RN / CNA / BLS · Forklift · None · Other. Role and certification lists are TBD with the client.

**Step 4 of 5 · How it runs today.** "How do you schedule today?" (required) Spreadsheets · Paper or whiteboard · Group texts · Another scheduling tool · HR system · "What breaks most often?" (optional, up to 2) Last-minute call-outs · Overtime cost · Expired certifications · Demand surges · Swaps and time-off · "When do you want this fixed?" (optional) This month · This quarter · Just exploring.

**Step 5 of 5 · What's next.** "What would you like to do?" (required, last question so it lands in the file), 3 `mkt-result-card`s for everyone:
- Learn more about Blue Roster for [industry] (see industry rule)
- Book a demo: "A 20–45 minute demo."
- Try the light version: helper "Up to 50 users."

Contact (required for demo and light; optional for learn more): First name · Last name · Work email · Job title (optional) · Phone (optional), then the consent lines (rule 6). CTA **Continue**.

Approved stat per industry on the cards: Mfg 4.5 h saved per week · Health under 5 min to fill a gap · Logistics 18 min vs 22 hrs to staff a surge · General managers spend 216 h a year scheduling.

**After submit (D6–D9, Navy band, White primary button).**
- Redirect titles: Learn more "Taking you to Blue Roster for [industry]…" (general: "Taking you to Blue Roster…") · Demo "Taking you to booking…" + "We'll come in knowing your team." · Light "Opening the light version…"
- Fallback buttons (if the redirect stalls, approved): "Continue to Blue Roster for [industry]" (general: "Continue to Blue Roster") · "Open the calendar" · "Open the light version".
- `/light-version` placeholder (hidden, no-index): "The light version is almost ready." · "We saved your answers." · buttons "Book a demo" · "Learn more about Blue Roster for [industry]" (general: "Learn more about Blue Roster").

**Errors.** Required choice "Pick one to continue." · required text "Add your [company name / first name / last name] to continue." · email "Enter a valid work email." · consent "Check the box so we can reply." · submit failed "Something went wrong. Try again."

**Footer.** "© 2026 Blue Roster · Privacy (URL TBD) · blueroster.com".

### [industry] token rule

| Line | Manufacturing / Healthcare / Logistics | Food & beverage · Retail · Security & facilities · Other |
|---|---|---|
| Step 5 option | Learn more about Blue Roster for [industry] | Learn more about Blue Roster |
| Redirect title | Taking you to Blue Roster for [industry]… | Taking you to Blue Roster… |
| Fallback button | Continue to Blue Roster for [industry] | Continue to Blue Roster |
| /light-version button | Learn more about Blue Roster for [industry] | Learn more about Blue Roster |
