## Wix build notes

Copied from the team's `design/landing-wix-notes.md` (2026-10-19, final decisions by Matz). Field keys and element IDs are placeholders.

### Wix theme (Site Styles)

All Inter (Google Font in Wix). Black only for display and H1; H2–H4 Semi Bold.

| Wix theme text | mkt style | Desktop (1440) | Mobile (390) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Heading 1 | `mkt/display` | Inter Black 80 / 105%, −2.5 px | 48 / 110%, −1.5 |
| Heading 2 | `mkt/h1` | Inter Black 44 / 110%, −2.5 | 36 / 110%, −1.5 |
| Heading 3 | `mkt/h2` (step titles, question titles) | Inter Semi Bold 34 / 115%, −1.5 | 28 / 120%, −1 |
| Heading 4 | `mkt/h3` (choice cards) | Semi Bold 24 / 120%, −0.5 | 22 |
| Heading 5 | `mkt/h4` (field questions, option labels) | Semi Bold 20 / 130% | 18 |
| Paragraph 1 | `mkt/lead` | Regular 22 / 140% | 18 |
| Paragraph 2 | `mkt/body` | Regular 16 / 140% | 16 |
| Paragraph 3 | `mkt/small` | Regular 14 / 140% | 14 |
| Button | `mkt/button` | Bold 16 / 125% | 16 |
| (eyebrow, set per element) | `mkt/eyebrow` | Bold 14, UPPER, +1.5 | 12, +1.2 |

Wix scales type with the viewport: set desktop values on the 1440 breakpoint and mobile values on the mobile breakpoint by hand.

- **Colors (Light page):** page `#F9F9F9` · cards/fields `#FFFFFF` · headings `#002458` · body `#111827` · muted `#535353` · dividers `#D1D5DB` · primary button `#064DB7` with `#F9F9F9` text (7.25:1) · progress/hover accent `#1E75F6` (non-text only) · selected tint `#C7DDFD`.
- **Navy band (confirmation section only):** bg `#002458` · primary button `#F9F9F9` with `#002458` text (14.32:1) · body `#C7DDFD` · muted/eyebrow `#8EBAFA`.
- **Industry accents on Step 5 cards:** Mfg `#1E75F6` / text `#064DB7` / tint `#C7DDFD` · Health `#14B8A6` / `#13726E` / `#CBECE8` · Logistics `#BA7517` / `#87591C` / `#ECDFCC` · General `#9CA3AF` / `#5F6673` / `#E6E8EA`. Health and General accent bars are decorative only (under 3:1).
- **Orange:** `#F66C1E` highlights and illustration only, never a button; Navy text on it, never white. Not used in the form UI.
- **Not in mkt:** error red `#B42318` (literal, flagged as a gap).
- **Grid:** 12 col, 24 gutter, 80 margin, 1280 max at 1440 · 4 col, 16 gutter, 20 margin at 390.

### Figma piece → Wix element

| Figma | Wix |
|---|---|
| Header (logo only) / Footer | Site header + footer: "© 2026 Blue Roster · Privacy (URL TBD) · blueroster.com". No header CTA. |
| D0 Hero | Section: text + button (scrolls to / opens the form) + image (blue man exported as SVG/PNG from `br-blue-men`) |
| One Wix Form, 5 pages | **Wix Forms multi-step** ("Pages"), one page per step |
| `mkt-progress` + "Step N of 5" | No native progress bar: "Step N of 5" in each page title; the segmented bar is optional decoration |
| `mkt-option-card` · Single | **Single choice** field (radio) styled as cards |
| `mkt-option-card` · Multi | **Multi choice** field (checkboxes). "Up to 2" on pain: confirm Wix can cap it, otherwise validate in Velo |
| `mkt-text-field` | **Short text** (Company name, First/Last name, Job title) · **Email** (Work email) · **Phone** |
| `mkt-select` | **Dropdown** Country: **United States** (default) · Other. "Other" shows a Short text field by a Rule. Market: US only (Mexico removed). |
| `mkt-checkbox` × 2 + notice | Rule 6 lines. Checkbox A required when `next_step` = demo or light; notice as checkbox help text or a text element under it; checkbox B optional, unchecked, own column `consent_call_text` |
| Step 2 employees | **Single choice** ranges 1–49 · 50–200 · 201–500 · 500+ (sales data; no Rule depends on it) |
| Step 3 roles by industry | One Multi choice field per industry, shown by a **Rule** on `industry` |
| `mkt-result-card` (Step 5) | **Single choice** `next_step` (`learn_more` / `demo` / `light`), required, last question. All 3 options for everyone. Built as two fields (see below). Card stat and "Goes to…" lines are option descriptions or static text |
| Contact required for demo/light | **Rules**: name + work email + consent required when `next_step` = demo or light; optional for learn_more |
| `mkt-button` Back / Next / Continue | Form's own Previous / Next / Submit buttons (primary `#064DB7`) |
| D6–D8 confirmation (Navy band) | Form success message (or a short success section), then Velo redirect |
| D9 /light-version | Hidden, no-index page `/light-version` |

**Two `next_step` fields (industry label rule).** Wix Forms can't change an option label from an earlier answer, so (decision Hugo/István) use two fields + a Wix Rule, no Velo for the label:
- `next_step_industry`: "Learn more about Blue Roster for [industry]", "Book a demo", "Try the light version". Shown when `industry` = Manufacturing / Healthcare / Logistics.
- `next_step_general`: "Learn more about Blue Roster", "Book a demo", "Try the light version". Shown when `industry` = Food & beverage / Retail / Security & facilities / Other.
- Both store `learn_more` / `demo` / `light` and are required when visible. The Google Sheet automation merges them into one `next_step` column (or formula `=IF(A2<>"",A2,B2)`); Velo reads `v.next_step_industry || v.next_step_general`.

### Where the sales file comes from

1. Every submission lands in **Forms & Submissions**; CSV export is the backup (times in UTC).
2. **Wix Automation:** "Form submitted" → **Update Google Sheets** → sheet "BR · Questionnaire leads", one row per lead, every field mapped. If the Google permission is removed, skipped rows are not backfilled, so keep the CSV backup.
3. Hidden fields set by Velo: `lead_id`, `utm_source`, `utm_campaign`, `landing_url`.
4. Contact fields map to Wix Contacts. Demo bookings (Wix Bookings) join the row by **work email**.
5. Optional: automation email to sales, flag `next_step = demo` in the subject.

### Velo redirect + /light-version

Native redirect is one URL for everyone, so routing needs Velo (Dev Mode). Log `values` once; v2 choice fields return the option **value**, not the label.

```js
import wixLocationFrontend from 'wix-location-frontend';
const LIGHT_URL = '/light-version';               // swap for the real light version later (URL TBD)
// Only these industries have their own page and carry "for [industry]" in copy
const PAGES = { manufacturing: '/manufacturing', healthcare: '/healthcare', logistics: '/logistics' };
const NAMES = { manufacturing: 'Manufacturing', healthcare: 'Healthcare', logistics: 'Logistics' };
const GENERAL = '/';                              // TBD: '/' or '/active-scheduling' (Food, Retail, Security & facilities, Other)
const DEMO = '/booking-calendar/intro-to-blue-roster-software';
const hasPage = (ind) => Boolean(PAGES[ind]);
const forIndustry = (ind) => hasPage(ind) ? ` for ${NAMES[ind]}` : '';   // '' for general-page industries
let v = {};
$w.onReady(() => {
  const q = wixLocationFrontend.query;
  $w('#form').setFieldValues({ lead_id: crypto.randomUUID(), utm_source: q.utm_source || '', utm_campaign: q.utm_campaign || '', landing_url: wixLocationFrontend.url });
  $w('#form').onSubmit(values => { v = values; });
  $w('#form').onSubmitSuccess(() => {
    v.next_step = v.next_step_industry || v.next_step_general;   // two fields, one value
    const p = new URLSearchParams({ lead: v.lead_id, industry: v.industry, size: v.employee_bucket }).toString();
    if (v.next_step === 'demo')  return wixLocationFrontend.to(DEMO);
    if (v.next_step === 'light') return wixLocationFrontend.to(`${LIGHT_URL}?${p}`);
    // learn_more: confirmation copy + destination depend on whether the industry has its own page
    $w('#redirectTitle').text = `Taking you to Blue Roster${forIndustry(v.industry)}…`;
    $w('#fallbackButton').label = `Continue to Blue Roster${forIndustry(v.industry)}`;
    const url = hasPage(v.industry) ? PAGES[v.industry] : GENERAL;
    $w('#fallbackButton').link = url;
    wixLocationFrontend.to(url);
  });
});
// /light-version page code: same rule for its Learn more button
// const ind = wixLocationFrontend.query.industry;
// $w('#learnMoreButton').label = `Learn more about Blue Roster${forIndustry(ind)}`;
// $w('#learnMoreButton').link = hasPage(ind) ? PAGES[ind] : GENERAL;
```

- `/light-version` reads `lead`, `industry`, `size` from the query and offers Book a demo + Learn more. When the real light version exists, change `LIGHT_URL` only.
- No-code fallback if Velo is not allowed: one hidden "Next steps" page with 3 static buttons (Learn more can't follow the industry, and the click isn't in the file).

### Limitations / to confirm

- **Plan:** 5 form steps need Wix **Core / Business or higher** (Light allows 3 steps). Exact plan to be confirmed.
- No step branching in new Wix Forms (only show/hide/required Rules), so the 5 pages are fixed for everyone.
- No native progress bar and no native UTM capture (hidden fields + Velo).
- Choice fields have limited styling: cards may render as styled radios/checkboxes. Keep label, selected color and 3:1 control edges; the hover shadow can be dropped.
- Velo needs Dev Mode and someone to maintain it.
- **Privacy Policy page:** Wix has no policy generator; create it manually once the client/attorney fills the TBDs, and link it in the footer ("Privacy"), the form notice ("Privacy Policy") and the cookie banner. URL TBD.

## Open items (TBD, do not invent)

Privacy Policy page content and URL · call/text checkbox (keep only if sales calls/texts, incl. automated) · role and certification lists · general page URL (`/` or `/active-scheduling`) · light-version URL · exact Wix plan.

# marketing/banners.md

# Campaign banners

How to build Blue Roster social and display banners so they match the approved **Asset Library** and **Batch 01**. Tokens and type: [`foundations.md`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/marketing/foundations.md). Reference PNGs: [`references/`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/marketing/references/README.md).

Figma: banners file `95vgcOmJbHpvSOiLvybtZj`, page **"Asset Library"** (`1055:98`), which holds the cleaned library and the Batch 01 section (`1071:1400`). The page **"Social "** (`1:2`, trailing space) is the published history: read it, never edit it. Screen copies for banners live in Design System Legacy, page **"Marketing · Banner screens"** (`588:11872`); never edit the original product screens.

## Non-negotiable rules

1. **Approved stats only.** Never invent or alter stats, quotes, testimonials, customer names, logos or prices. If no approved stat fits, run a stat-free headline.
2. **Pricing never appears** in posts, banners or landings. Say **"light version"**, never "free", "free plan", "free trial" or "free under 50". (Legacy site CTA "Book a Free Demo" exists on a few older Generic pieces as verbatim site copy; do not add it to new pieces without art-direction approval.)
3. **Copy is verbatim**: headlines and body come from blueroster.com, an existing approved library line, or the approved stat wording. Trims may only drop the end of a sentence. Any new line is marked `NEW COPY — pending approval` and is not shipped.
4. **Links go in the FIRST COMMENT**, never in the caption or on the creative (a small `blueroster.com/{vertical}` footer URL on the creative is fine).
5. **No raw product screens**: no old dates, no lorem ipsum, **no real names**. Use roles and role initials.
6. **Accessibility**: text contrast **≥ 4.5:1** (check every text layer, including chips and footers), meaningful graphics and control edges ≥ 3:1, and check minimum sizes in every format (see table below). Color is never the only signal.
7. Posts in English. Tone: direct, non-salesy, **pain → mechanism → proof**. Hashtags: LinkedIn 3–5, Instagram 15–30, Facebook 0–2.

### Approved stats only

| Vertical | Approved wording |
|---|---|
| 🏭 Manufacturing | 4.5 h saved/week · <5 min to fill a shift · 100% OSHA cert enforced |
| 🏥 Healthcare | 100% cert verified · zero license gaps · <5 min gap filled |
| 🚛 Logistics | 18 min vs 22 hrs to staff a surge |
| 🌐 Generic | 216 h/year spent scheduling per manager |

Each piece carries **only its own vertical's** stat. Never move a stat to another vertical (e.g. 4.5 h on Generic), never tell a stat as a customer anecdote, and never use other site numbers (22%, 18%, $52K, 94%, +40%, 35%, $18K, "4 min", "3 hours", "0 open shifts", "go live in under a week"…).

## Formats

| Format | Size | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| LinkedIn feed | **1200x627** | Main format. One LI + one Square per piece minimum. |
| Square | **1080x1080** | LinkedIn / Instagram / Facebook feed. |
| Story | **1080x1920** | Instagram / Facebook Story. Keep text clear of the platform UI at the top and bottom (exact safe area: proposal, ~250 px). CTA "↑  Swipe up to learn more". Photos must be native resolution (no upscaled drafts). |
| Display | 300x250 · 728x90 · 300x600 | Library only; text + CTA, no screens. |

Minimum sizes: **check them on every format**. No sizes are approved yet; working **proposal** (flag anything smaller): body/support text ≥ 24 px on 1080/1200 formats, ≥ 12 px on Display; eyebrows/chips ≥ 20 px on 1080/1200; product-screen text inside a mockup must still read at feed size (crop or zoom the screen rather than shrinking it).

## Naming and library structure

Name every frame and PNG `{emoji} {Vertical} — {Topic} — {Format} {WxH}`, adding ` · 02`, ` · 03` when topic and format repeat. Emoji: 🏭 Manufacturing · 🏥 Healthcare · 🚛 Logistics · 🌐 Generic. Example: `🏭 Manufacturing — Shift Fill — LinkedIn 1200x627`. No week numbers in names or on the creative (eyebrow is "Blue Roster for {Vertical}" or "Blue Roster — Active Scheduling").

Asset Library v1 (105 pieces), sections by vertical → topic:

| Vertical | Topics |
|---|---|
| 🏭 Manufacturing | Shift Fill · Call-Outs · Active Scheduling · Certifications · Time Saved |
| 🏥 Healthcare | Certifications · Switching · Coverage Heat Map · Coverage Gaps · Call-Outs |
| 🚛 Logistics | Surge · Coverage Heat Map · Call-Outs |
| 🌐 Generic | Active Scheduling · Time Spent · Demand Matching · Time-Off · Call-Outs · Brand |

Batch 01 (Demand Matching + Time-Off × 4 verticals): 8 pieces × LI / Square / Story; object-photo Stories stay on hold until their photos are approved.

## The 5 families and rotation

| Family | What it is | Batch 01 example |
|---|---|---|
| **Big Number (BN)** | Giant approved-stat numeral (Inter Black) + Semi Bold statement line + body + CTA. Light or Navy background. | A1 Mfg "<5 min to fill a shift." (light) · B1 Health "<5 min gap filled." (Navy) |
| **Icon/Chart (IC)** | Simple diagram (Venn, dot grid, heat map, stat tiles) or redrawn product-UI panel. | A3 Logistics Venn "Open Shifts · Certified & Available · ✓ Matched" + "18 min vs 22 hrs" tiles |
| **Documentary photo (DP)** | Candid workplace photo + Navy panel/gradient with text. Open space low-left for text; screens read as a soft glow. | A2 Health (nurse at a station), B2 Logistics (supervisor in a DC office) |
| **Object photo (OP)** | Still life of a work object (desk calendar, hard hat, shift board). | A4 Generic, B4 Mfg (drafts, pending approval) |
| **Doodle "blue men" (DD)** | Blue men illustration (editable vectors, brand-mapped colors), Blue Light background. About once a month. | B3 Generic "Still guessing who covers a day off?" |

Rotation: never the same family twice in one week; doodle about once a month; each vertical uses at least two families; in the Instagram grid never put two solid-color pieces (BN, IC, DD) next to each other: alternate solid and photo.

## Layout and styling (as built in the library)

- **Type:** Inter only. Main headline Inter **Black 900**, tracking −2.5 px at 40–100 px, about −3% below 40 px, about −4.5% on giant numerals > 100 px. Secondary heavy text Semi Bold, body Regular. No Light/ExtraLight/Bold headlines.
- **Palette only:** Navy `#002458`, Blue `#1E75F6`, Blue Light `#C7DDFD`, White `#F9F9F9` (not `#FFFFFF`), Dark `#111827`, plus vertical accents (Mfg `#1E75F6`, Health `#14B8A6`, Logistics `#BA7517`, Generic `#9CA3AF`) and orange `#F66C1E` (rules below).
- **CTAs:** on Navy → White `#F9F9F9` fill with Navy text. On light, Manufacturing → `#064DB7` with White text; other verticals on light → Navy fill with White text. CTA copy from existing pieces: "Book a {Vertical} Demo →".
- **`#1E75F6` is never text.** Blue text becomes Blue Light on Navy and Navy on light. `#1E75F6` stays for non-text accents (Mfg rules/bars, eyebrow dot, doodle figure).
- **Grey `#9CA3AF` is decorative only** (Generic dots and rules), never text.
- **Highlighted headline words** use the vertical accent only where it passes on that background (Health teal, Logistics ochre on Navy); Mfg and Generic highlights on Navy use Blue Light.
- **Orange `#F66C1E`:** highlights and illustration accessories only (e.g. the blue men Mfg vest), never a background block for text and never a button. Any text on orange is Navy `#002458` (5.08:1), never white (2.82–2.97:1).
- **Eyebrow/status chips:** on dark, 15% Blue Light tint with Blue Light text; on light, solid Blue Light with Navy text.
- **Status colors in UI mocks (heat maps):** covered = Blue `#1E75F6`, partial = Blue Light `#C7DDFD`, gap = Dark `#111827` with a diagonal hatch **and** a "GAP" label. Checks are White ✓ on Blue.
- **Logo:** always the `BR-Logo` component (light-on-dark version on Navy, `BR-Logo [Day]` on light). Never typed "Blue Roster.com", never redrawn; no ".com" suffix next to it.
- **No visible internal labels** ("Week 4", placeholders, notes) on the creative.

## Banners with system screens (client priority)

Connect the promotion with the demo by showing real Blue Roster screens. Use the clean captures in Design System Legacy page "Marketing · Banner screens" (copies; originals untouched), exported at **2x**. Light versions are in [`references/screens/`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpablomatz/blueroster-design-system/main/marketing/references/README.md).

| Screen | Capture | Headline (approved, sentence case + period) | Support line |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Attendance Today** (admin, desktop 1440) | `attendance-today-light@2x.png` (2880×1800). Crop just below the table. | **Never get caught short-staffed.** (site: /active-scheduling/coverage-gaps) | Optional "Under 5 min to fill a shift." (Mfg only); omit on Generic |
| **My Schedule Day** (employee mobile, 5 event types) | `my-schedule-day-light@2x.png` (780×1688) | **Time off requests, simplified.** (site: /active-scheduling/time-off-requests) · swaps alt: **Shift swaps without the headache.** (site: /active-scheduling/shift-swaps) | — |
| **Overtime cards** (employee mobile, incl. the locked "Forklift cert." card) | `overtime-cards-full-light@2x.png` (780×3020, all 4 cards) | **Cut overtime costs automatically.** (site: /active-scheduling/overtime-costs) | **No stat** (35% and $18K are not approved) |

Headline rule: take the headline **verbatim from blueroster.com** (site lines are Title Case) and set it in **sentence case with a final period**, as in Batch 01. Do not add claims.

Screen data rules:
- **Role-based example data, no real names**: rows and cards show roles (e.g. "Welder · Line 2", Operator, Line Lead, Inspector, RN, CNA) with role initials (OP, LL, QI, RN, CA). No real or realistic person names, no customer names.
- **Current dates** (the captures use the week of Mon 19 Oct 2026); never old dates or lorem ipsum.
- Prefer **Light** captures. In Dark, light-blue task blocks with white text have low contrast.
- Mockup layout per format (**proposal**, pending art direction): LinkedIn 1200x627 = headline left, screen right (cropped/zoomed); 1080x1080 = headline top, screen below; Story = headline top, tall screen (Overtime full capture) below the safe area. Place the screen inside a device or browser frame drawn with palette colors; keep product UI in its own Roboto/`--br-*` styling.
- Known flaws inherited from the product designs (do not "fix" or highlight): the Attendance side menu highlights "Action Center", and the notification badge is clipped at the top.

## Checklist before handing off

- [ ] Name follows `{emoji} {Vertical} — {Topic} — {Format} {WxH}`; all required formats exported at 1:1 (screens at 2x).
- [ ] Every line traced to blueroster.com, an approved library line, or an approved stat (keep a source table).
- [ ] Only the vertical's own approved stat, or none. No quotes, testimonials, prices or "free".
- [ ] No real names, old dates or lorem ipsum in screens.
- [ ] Text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 on every layer; minimum sizes checked per format; orange only with Navy text.
- [ ] Family rotation respected for the week; no two solids adjacent in the IG grid.
- [ ] Link planned for the first comment; hashtags within the channel range.
- [ ] Art-direction review before anything is uploaded or published.

# tokens/marketing.css

/* Blue Roster · Marketing foundations (mkt) v0.5 — 19 Oct 2026
 * Marketing layer only. It does not touch tokens.css (s2d product tokens) or the br-* components.
 * Figma: Design System Legacy (k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq), page "Marketing · Foundations" (561:21), board 566:80.
 * Collections: mkt · primitives, mkt (Light / Navy band), mkt · layout (1440/1024/768/390).
 * Status per value (sourced / derived / proposal / approved) is in tokens/marketing.md.
 * Approved by István 2026-10-18:
 *  1. Display 80px at 1440 (mobile 48).
 *  2. H2 Semi Bold 600; Black only for display and H1; H3/H4 Semi Bold.
 *  3. No Dark pages. Second mode = "Navy band": wrap content placed on Navy #002458 sections in
 *     [data-mkt-band="navy"] (or .mkt-band-navy). Light is the default on :root.
 *  4. Manufacturing buttons use #064DB7 (--mkt-vertical-mfg-accent-strong); #1E75F6 stays the accent for non-text.
 *  5. Primary buttons inside a Navy band are White #F9F9F9 with Navy #002458 text (14.32:1):
 *     --mkt-action-primary / --mkt-action-on-primary (and Mfg accent-strong in Navy band).
 * Every block holds resolved values (no var() chains), so a Navy band nested in a Light page re-resolves correctly.
 *  6. (Matz, 2026-10-19) Secondary accent orange #F66C1E from Matz's Styleguide "Secondary/Default"
 *     (ramp #903502 -> #FFCDB1): --mkt-accent-secondary. Text on it is Navy (--mkt-accent-on-secondary,
 *     5.08:1), never white (2.97:1). Non-text on the page bg (2.82:1 on #F9F9F9): highlights and
 *     illustration accessories only, not buttons. For orange text use --mkt-orange-900 (7.4:1).
 */
